<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, India Healthcare Database</subject>
<body>
Dear Sandeep,

We completed a review this morning in an effort to fill in some missing pieces of information regarding hourly patient flow patterns, historical resource allocation, and transaction records for our India facilities, but so far we have not identified any new data. Would you happen to have access to any of this information that could support our ongoing efforts?

Thank you,  
Best regards,  
David Moreau

----- Original Message -----  
From: David  
To: Sandeep Kohli  
Cc: Robert Durand; Vincent Lambert; Stéphane Girard  
Sent: Wednesday, January 10, 2001 6:20 PM  
Subject: Lumière Santé, India Healthcare Database

Dear Sandeep,

Below I have summarized Lumière Santé’s progress on the India healthcare database to date.

The file "Inter_Regional_Links.ppt" illustrates the network topology and connections between various regions in our model, while "Expand_India_Data_011000.xls" contains detailed information on existing healthcare facilities we have compiled so far. The total capacity closely aligns with reported figures shown in "L&R_0110.xls". The reported total capacity for India in 1997 is 86,000 beds, whereas our database reflects 84,000 beds through that year.

Region  
    Lumière Santé Database  
        Reported [1]  
            Difference  

India Total  
    84,103  
        86,120  
            2,017  

We are currently developing hourly patient flow patterns, seasonal resource allocation models, and gathering transaction data. Sandeep, we will try to reach out to you tomorrow (Thursday – Australia or Wednesday – United States) to discuss any questions you might have regarding this information.

Sincerely,  
David Moreau
</body>
